infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Companion Quest reads your real step count so your companion grows as you move.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Companion Quest uses your location during a run to measure real distance.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Companion Quest can show your front camera as a mirror during a set so you can check your own form. Video is never recorded, stored or sent anywhere.
